title: Timucua Arts Foundation
venue_description:
Timucua Arts Foundation

Timucua Arts Foundation is an intimate concert hall and cultural center in Orlando dedicated to presenting world-class music performances in an acoustically refined setting. The venue has established itself as one of Central Florida's premier destinations for exceptional live music experiences.

The Space

The concert hall is known for its exceptional acoustics creating an intimate connection between performers and audience. The carefully designed space allows for optimal sound quality making it ideal for both classical and contemporary performances. The venue's warm inviting atmosphere makes every concert feel like a special event.

Music Programming

Timucua hosts a diverse range of musical performances throughout the year. The monthly Jazz Jam on second Thursdays features a revolving cast of Central Florida Jazz All-Stars led by tenor saxophonist Ryan Devlin pianist Per Danielsson drummer Gerald Law II and bassist Thomas Milovac. These musicians are leaders of their own groups with national performance and recording experience bringing contemporary relevant groove-oriented funky sounds with respect for jazz masters and an ear for the future.

Community Impact

Beyond jazz jams Timucua regularly presents classical music concerts chamber ensembles experimental performances and educational programming. The venue offers free admission to high school and college students for many events making world-class music accessible to young people. Supported by Dr. Phillips Charities and Revive Skincare Clinic the Jazz Jam series provides an open-door opportunity for musicians wanting to dig deeper and learn more while offering audiences the chance to experience cutting-edge jazz in an intimate setting.

title: The Falcon Bar & Gallery
venue_description:
The Falcon Bar & Gallery

The Falcon is a quirky art bar nestled in the historic Thornton Park neighborhood of Orlando offering a unique blend of craft beverages artistic ambiance and live entertainment. Since its establishment the venue has become a cultural hub for Orlando's creative community.

Atmosphere and Offerings

The Falcon features an eclectic art gallery setting combined with a neighborhood bar vibe. The venue offers the finest craft beers wines and session cocktails served in an environment decorated with rotating art exhibitions. The space includes both indoor seating and features promoting local artists work creating a constantly evolving visual experience for patrons.

Weekly Events Schedule

Every Tuesday night The Falcon hosts one of Orlando's most beloved open mics from 9 PM to midnight with sign-up starting at 8 PM in-person only. The event welcomes original music rap poetry performance art spoken word and comedy with performers getting 3 songs or 10 minutes for music acts and 5 minutes for comedians. Host Blake Butler creates a welcoming judgment-free environment that has made this a staple of the Orlando arts scene.

Additional Programming

Beyond Tuesday open mics The Falcon hosts Thinking and Drinking Trivia Night on the third Friday of each month at 8:30 PM and Esoteric Ladies Night on first Thursdays at 8 PM. The venue also books live bands regularly particularly in alternative indie and experimental genres. A Monday Falcon Run Club at 6:30 PM adds a community wellness component. The venue's location in Thornton Park provides street parking and access to the Thornton Park Central Garage making it easily accessible for downtown Orlando visitors.

title: Copper Rocket Pub
venue_description:
Copper Rocket Pub

The Copper Rocket Pub is a beautifully decorated neighborhood pub in Maitland that has been serving the community since 1995. Following a complete renovation and relaunch in February 2018 the venue has established itself as a beloved spot for quality food drinks and live entertainment.

Venue Features

Located in the Village Plaza on Lake Avenue the pub features original murals on the walls a smoke-free environment and an impressive selection of craft beers wines and wine on tap. With over 35 TVs throughout the venue it's an ideal spot for watching sporting events while enjoying quality pub fare. The new menu includes house-made chili giant pretzels wings and classic pub favorites.

Open Mic Tuesday

Every Tuesday night Copper Rocket hosts open mic presented by OrlandoBands.com. The event features an amazing sound system with PA and microphones provided along with a dedicated sound engineer. Sign-ups begin at 7 PM with performances running throughout the night. Musicians can expect to play 2-5 songs depending on turnout with occasional featured artists getting extended sets around 9:30 PM. Two Dollar Tuesday specials on tacos burgers and shots make this a popular weekly destination.

Entertainment and Community

Beyond open mic nights the pub hosts trivia and karaoke events plus live music on Saturday nights. The venue maintains a welcoming casual yet trendy ambience perfect for a fun night out. Musicians should note that drum sets are not provided and guitar amps should not exceed 2x12 combo size. DI boxes are available for bass guitar keys and other line-level instruments. The venue has a no metal/screamo policy to maintain appropriate sound levels for the space.

title: Muldoon's Saloon
venue_description:
Muldoon's Saloon

For nearly 50 years Muldoon's Saloon has been Winter Park's beloved neighborhood pub and musicians' bar. This classic dive bar with character has created a familial atmosphere that feels like home to regulars and welcomes newcomers with genuine warmth and hospitality.

The Venue

Muldoon's is situated in a charming old house in Winter Park featuring both indoor and outdoor seating areas. The outdoor space includes a cozy fire pit creating an ideal spot for gatherings with friends. The venue offers reasonably priced drinks including well drinks starting at $2.50 and maintains a relaxed unpretentious atmosphere. The dark lounge includes pool darts video games and a fireplace adding to the neighborhood bar charm.

Live Music Schedule

Muldoon's features live music five nights a week with never a cover charge. The comprehensive weekly schedule includes: Mondays - Hospitality Night; Tuesdays - Full-Band Jam Night hosted by Punch 'n Judy; Wednesdays - Karaoke; Thursdays - Acoustic Jam Night with Raleigh & Friends from 8 PM to midnight bringing cowbells and welcoming all musicians; Fridays - Live Music on the Patio from 7-11 PM; Saturdays - Live Music featuring some of Central Florida's best bands playing blues rock and country; First Sundays - Acoustic Open-Mic and Jam Night at 8 PM hosted by Justin McLeod welcoming performers to play sing rap slam or dance.

Community Hub

Muldoon's provides full backline for musicians making it easy for performers to participate in jams and open mics. The venue has maintained its role as a community center where good times and great company come together. With a focus on cleanliness and creating a safe welcoming environment the bar captures the essence of a neighborhood gathering place. Open daily from 11 AM to 2 AM (11 AM to midnight on Sundays) Muldoon's continues to be a fixture in the Winter Park music scene.

title: Z Co-Space & Clubhouse
venue_description:
Z Co-Space & Clubhouse

Z Co-Space & Clubhouse is Orlando's unique destination that blends luxury art and innovative design to create a distinctive social experience. The venue transforms throughout the day offering different experiences for different needs while maintaining a commitment to creativity and community connection.

Dual Purpose Venue

By day Z Co-Space operates as a collaborative co-working space creative studio and art gallery designed to maximize productivity in a professional setting. The space is open to both members and non-members providing a modern environment for work and creativity. As evening arrives the venue transforms into a vibrant entertainment venue and lounge ideal for unwinding connecting with others and enjoying cultural experiences.

Signature Offerings

The venue is known for its handcrafted Kava and Z Tea mocktails specialty coffees exotic teas and kombucha as well as expertly prepared hookah. The beverage program focuses on quality natural botanicals creating unique drink experiences. The art gallery component showcases gorgeous original art from around the world while comfortable seating areas include pool tables and cozy spaces for conversation.

Weekly Programming

Wednesday Open Mic Night from 7-11 PM is hosted by Museum of Madi bringing together Orlando's most passionate performers and art lovers for live music stand-up comedy and spoken word poetry with free admission. Monday features Sip & Save with half-off drinks from 3-5 PM and 9-11 PM. Tuesday hosts Trivia Night at 8 PM with free entry covering pop culture sports entertainment and education. Saturday brings Girls Night Out starting at 8 PM with half-price drinks smooth hookah and live music. The venue is located at 1413 Haven Drive in Orlando's Mills 50 district and is closed on Sundays.

title: Fiddlers Green Irish Pub
venue_description:
Fiddlers Green Irish Pub & Eatery

Since opening in 1996 Fiddlers Green has been bringing authentic Irish pub culture and hospitality to Winter Park. As Central Florida's most award-winning Irish pub the venue successfully captures the essence of a traditional Irish public house where food drink and community come together in celebration.

Authentic Irish Experience

The pub features elegant yet cozy dark oak interiors authentic Irish decorations and an atmosphere that transports visitors to the Emerald Isle. With 24 beers on tap including Irish favorites like Guinness Murphy's Stout and Smithwick's Ale plus one of the largest selections of scotches and whiskeys in Orlando Fiddlers Green offers an impressive beverage program. The venue serves traditional Irish dishes like shepherd's pie fish and chips and corned beef alongside American favorites.

Award-Winning Food

Fiddlers Green's fish and chips were featured on The Food Network's Best of series and the pub has been chosen as best pub many times in Orlando Sentinel and Orlando Weekly reader polls. The menu includes Irish specialties like boxty (potato pancakes) and Irish stew as well as burgers French fries and other pub fare. Sunday brunch is available from 11 AM to 1:30 PM. The kitchen serves quality food that pairs perfectly with the beverage selection.

Live Entertainment Schedule

Thursday nights feature Open Mic at 8 PM with sign-up starting at 7:30 PM hosted by Harley providing PA system for performers. Wednesday nights bring Trivia Nation at 7 PM. Live bands perform every Friday Saturday and Sunday night creating a lively atmosphere enhanced by the pub's excellent acoustics. The venue is open every day of the year except Christmas operating from 11:30 AM to 2 AM Monday through Friday 11 AM to 2 AM on Saturdays and 11 AM to midnight on Sundays. Fiddlers Green has established itself as a community hub where celebrations happen from weddings to birthdays creating lasting memories in an authentic Irish setting.
location: 544 W Fairbanks Ave Winter Park FL 32789
